followup_reviews.Research finding: Retain the announced maintenance service suspension as an ordered window. The inspected articles do not prove its implementation or observed reopening. IGM/SAT describe a complete entry/exit suspension at the named integrated Guatemala–Honduras post for bridge-entrance paving and recommend alternatives. The announced 24 May 18:00 to 26 May 06:00 schedule is 36 hours and spans two date boundaries. The two-day calendar fields stay labelled as schedule evidence; complete/exact operational flags stay zero. Administration/service-operation coding follows the stated maintenance reason. It is not recoded as a protest, accidental failure or inferred security measure. The government news article was freshly read and the local article reused. Both report the IGM/SAT announcement and do not constitute two independent observations of operation. The phase remains unlocated. The crossing is named in the sources, but no precise bridge or control-point coordinate was verified in this audit.

Apply seven guarded baseline cell refinements: cancellation/nonimplementation wording forSUP-004, local-resident reopening scope for quarantinedR3-SC-004, and correlated schedule alternatives forSUP-002 so a false0–2day range is not calculated. Retain both quarantine decisions and all existing source/date/continuity/geographic limits. Accept the baseline challenger’s source-language, goods-attribution and Greek article-number refinements plus the additional limited source readings. The eight new parents require no further factual changes: preserve their cohort, policy/schedule, day-level, unknown-endpoint and location qualifications. This is a completed audit procedure for the sample, not proof every attribute or every record in the register is verified.
